sources.entry: What To Cook? - Get a recipe to cook today, based on the ingredients you have at home. AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: What To Cook? is a self-hosted app that suggests a recipe to cook today based on the ingredients you have at home.
summary.what_it_does: The project suggests one recipe at a time, adapting the suggestion to the ingredients the user has available. The README is very short: it says the app is run with Docker Compose, using an example file at examples/docker-compose.yml. The Demo and Screenshots sections are empty, so the README does not show the interface or describe features in detail. Other details such as how recipes are stored or how ingredients are entered are not stated in the README.
use_cases: pick a dinner recipe from leftover ingredients
reduce food waste by using what is at home
how_to_run: Use Docker Compose with the example file at examples/docker-compose.yml in the repository
notable: Suggests one recipe based on ingredients you have on hand
Runs via Docker Compose with an example configuration provided
Listed in awesome-selfhosted under Recipe Management
caveats: README is very short; Demo and Screenshots sections are empty and no detailed feature list is given
Setup instructions are minimal and point to an external example file for details
